notes.title: KKCKC 0.6 Update
notes.content:
[h1]KKCKC 0.6 Version has been updated.[/h1]



[h2]Keyboard Selection[/h2]
[h3]You can now choose your preferred keyboard![/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44369828/a9ef854221f054ee096f37467043dfa03ae3429c.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[list][*] From typewriters without arrow keys, to familiar keyboards, to powerful gaming keyboards![/list]

[h2]No Arrow Key[/h2]
[h3]A true keyboard game must support even the 60% layout without arrow keys.[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44369828/3d97d8eb3177d82cd8bad7c20ae5664af5314945.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[list][*] Added a setting to play without using arrow keys![/list]

[h3]New Keycaps[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 27 new ability keycaps.
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the abilities of the “Jet Pack” and “Wings” keycaps.
[*] The “Super Mushroom” passive keycap has been changed to an active keycap.
[/list]

[h3]Visual[/h3]
[list]
[*] Completely improved the icons of keycaps and achievements.
[*] Improved the visibility of the “Matrix” theme.
[*] Improved the visual effects of the “Molotov” active keycap.
[*] Added boss defeat effects.
[*] Improved hit and defeat effects.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where text was not displayed correctly in certain situations.
[*] Fixed an issue occurring when using the “Slot Machine” keycap.
[*] Fixed the shield position when obtaining the “Holy Shield” keycap.
[*] Fixed an issue where the “Linked Bullet” keycap did not function correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the “Indicator” keycap did not function correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cable’s position was not recognized properly in the cable boss battle.
[*] Fixed an issue where the microphone collision was not recognized properly in the sound boss battle.
[/list]

[h3]Else[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 23 achievements.
[*] Added 3 themes.
[*] Added 16 caps.
[/list]

notes.title: KKCKC 0.5 Update
notes.content:
[h1]KKCKC 0.5 Version has been updated.[/h1]



[h2]Gamepad Electronics Appears[/h2]
[h3]A new electronics has appeared, threatening the place of the Keyboard Key last one![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44369828/21cfe727623df0493138ecb34757fff45c13afed.png[/img]

[h3]A new switch has been created to destroy electronics more effectively![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44369828/03dd874bc3da48ea7a2be3f6a2331568e52d0a32.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[*] Destroy electronics with the Magnetic Switch, combining the [u]convenience[/u] of the [i]Red Switch[/i] and the [u]threat[/u] of the [b]Blue Switch[/b]!
[/list]

[h3]New Keycaps[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 20 new ability keycaps.  
[*] Active keycaps no longer take the slot of passive keycaps.  
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted hitbox detection.  
[*] Adjusted the tier and unlock conditions of keycaps.  
[*] Increased the abilities of actives.  
[*] Improved the functionality of status effects.  
[*] Adjusted the overall amount of currency obtained.  
[/list]

[h3]Effect Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved selection effects.  
[*] Enhanced effects such as explosions and flames.  
[*] Improved destruction effects of each electronics.  
[*] Added sound effects in Event Rooms.  
[*] Improved background music transitions in Battle Rooms.  
[*] Added effects when selecting keycaps.  
[*] Added "Quick Restart" to the pause menu.  
[*] Improved settings related to screen shake.  
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where progress did not continue after battle in some situations.  
[*] Fixed a bug where some ability keycaps were not functioning properly.  
[/list]

[h3]Else[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 9 new themes.  
[/list]

notes.title: KKCKC 0.2 Update
notes.content:
[h2]KKCKC 0.2 version has been updated.[/h2]



[h3]UI Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] The active UI position has been changed to the bottom space bar position.
[*] We changed the UI position of the coin and timer to the bottom.
[*] Improved UI for active use.
[*] The UI of the clear screen has been slightly overhauled.
[/list]

[h3]Active Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Update the cooltime of some active by the hour.
[*] Added default active for each switches.
[/list]

[h3]Game Play[/h3]
[list]
[*] In the keycap selection situation, we added a function to move on without selecting the keycap.
[*] The more you continue to fight, the more difficult the room becomes.
[*] The price of the keycap in the store has changed.
[*] 'Recovery' keycap do not take up a place in the keycaps compartment.
[*] 'Recovery' keycap do not appear in combat.
[*] A 'ReRecovery' keycap appears with a low probability in the recovery room.
[*] Increases damage to long characters such as 'SHIFT' and 'ENTER' on the red switch.
[/list]

[h3]Convenience[/h3]
[list]
[*] A quick start function has been added on the intro screen.
[*] Credit has been added on the main screen.
[*] Added the destruction effect of cable electronic devices.
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the hp of some electronic devices.
[*] The sound wave launch speed of the earphone electronic device has been increased.
[*] The 'Sticky Key' keycap can only be used on the red switch.
[*] 'Timing Typing' is also applied when obtaining the 'Sticky Key' keycap.
[*] The 'Shield' protect you just once, as explained.
[*] Changed the cooltime of some active items.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the 'Blood Sucking' active bug.
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred when moving from the setting to the book room.
[/list]
